profile.headline: Business Owner @ Viterra Realty Inc | Real Estate Software Developer
profile.summary:
With over 20 years of experience in the real estate and software development fields, I am a business owner who combines analytical prowess, communication skills, and creative vision to deliver exceptional results for my clients and myself. My mission is to leverage my expertise in both domains to create innovative solutions that enhance the value and efficiency of the real estate market. I am passionate about finding and creating opportunities for investment, development, and promotion, and I enjoy collaborating with diverse and talented teams across disciplines and industries.

As the business owner of Viterra Realty, I manage all aspects of my real estate business, from website development and maintenance, to market analysis and strategy, to negotiation and closing. I use my software skills (C++, PHP, Java, HTML, UI design) to create and maintain my website SoldByTroy.com, which serves as a data, marketing, and communication portal for my business and clients. I also specialize in finding and securing investment property deals, both for resale and rental, and I have a keen eye for the construction process and costs. I have helped hundreds of buyers and sellers achieve their real estate goals, with unparalleled attention to detail and service.

positions.title: Product Owner | Full-Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Gwynn Oak, Maryland, United States · On-site
positions.description:
The internet revolutionized how consumers access real estate information, and interact with agents, lenders and other industry professionals.  To support my real estate marketing, web design and application development is an integral component of my daily business tasks.  

A soon-to-be-released Real Estate App will help people buying real estate more easily navigate the decision-making process and build better rapport and communication of goals with their real estate agent.

Here are some highlights of the app:
• Encrypted Login System
• Session/Cookie Management
• Role-Based User Access
• MySQL DB Backend
• Custom Messaging
• RESTful API/CLI for future UI overlay options using React/Vue/Angular
• Mobile-First Responsive UI/UX Design
• Node.js based server
• Express.js route management for APIs (C.R.U.D.)
• MySQL 8 database for all data
• JWT user authentication & Session Management
• Javascript / CSS / Html 5, Bootstrap 5 based responsive client
• Brevo Email integration
• EJS (Embedded JavaScript)
• Axios for client/server communication
• Visual Studio v 17.7
• Apache Cordova container integration for iOS and Android
• AWS cloud deployment

Here are some highlights of a decade of web development  within the business, featuring over a dozen
real estate websites which helped generate over $100M in real estate sales revenue:

• PHP-based server code from scratch (i.e. no CMS)
• Core site library for shared resources amongst dozens of sites
• Custom Multi-Page Form System
• Bootstrap 4.x Responsive Mobile-first UI
• Tight integration to CRM and email systems.
• Custom integration to 3rd Party IDX APIs.
• SEO Optimization using search-friendly URL slug alias to content
• Domain Management and Server Configuration through CPanel / Apache Tomcat
• Wamp Server local environment
• Direct SSH Integration for revision control of code (NetBeans)
• TLS configuration to ensure only secure "https" communications
• Orchestration of Google PPC & Facebook Marketing Campaigns.

positions.title: VP of Product Development
positions.description:
Lead software development team through 4 product life cycles to of the Perspective flagship product,
a secure communications server (installed in both commercial and government sites) designed to promote remote work and disaster recovery. Tasks included:

• Created and managed product schedule through weekly engineering meetings and project-specific
progress meetings
• Delegated tasks and projects based on engineering team skill sets.
• Lead the effort in hiring and educating engineering team members
• Performed annual engineer competency reviews
• Instituted Engineer Code Reviews and Peer Assessment
• Developed a new method for managing and mentoring engineers to increase productivity and futureviability for team and company expansion.
• Attend marketing/investment/technical events to promote product and explore avenues for networking
and company expansion
Technical Tasks
• Assisted with product design from a user interface and functionality requirements perspective.
• Designed software architecture and programmatic interfaces using a myriad of technologies including
C++, Java, MySql, Redhat Linux, Windows NT Device Driver Kits, VirtualPC
• Managed development tools acquisition, setup, configuration and integration to existing systems
• Programmed and integrated Windows NDIS and Linux-TUN VPN subsystem, which has since served as
a core technology of the Perspective product
• Designed and developed RRS, a secure remote computer management and access technology, which
has since served as a core feature offering of Perspective.
• Debugged the most challenging bugs in all aspects of the product feature set prior to critical ship dates
• Assisted in design of patented encryption technology called SecureChannel which allows an encrypted
communication tunnel between users and computing resources
• Pioneered integration effort of RSA SecurID product feature by communicating with representatives
from RSA and teaching staff how to use the system

positions.title: Realtor
positions.description: Started my entry real estate career and learned the business of working with buyers and sellers primarily in residential real estate.

positions.title: C++ Developer
positions.description:
Imaging Team Software Engineer for the renowned VectorWorks CAD Application, trusted by top
architectural firms. This was my first team-oriented software job out of college. A team of about 25
developers worked on a shrink-wrapped high-end international CAD software. 

Most of my projects revolved around implementation of algorithms supporting import and export of common image and video file formats to/from the application. I was trusted to handle zero-fault-tolerance level coding and debugging.

A brief summary of this work experience:
• Object-oriented design, development, debugging and testing of code in a cross-platform (Mac/Win)
environment
• Floating point upgrade from Fixed to 64-bit double throughout the product (involved debugging and
testing tens of thousands of lines of code already written into the functioning product)
• Developed Apple QuickTime movie scripting API for product SDK
• Ported QuickTime plug-ins from Mac to Win in DLL/Shared Lib architecture
• Integrated QuickTime for importing/exporting images
• EPS translation support and maintenance
• Postscript printing architecture integration with drawing engine
• TIFF export algorithm design and implementation
• Ported C++ SDK to Java (over 800 SDK functions) to increase pool of external developers and bring
product forward to more accessible language
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Data Structures · Algorithms · Defining Requirements
